title: ElementInternals: Add a capability to set the default focus behavior

labels.name: topic: custom elements
labels.description: Relates to custom elements (as defined in DOM and HTML)

body:
This commit introduces 'focusBehavior' IDL attribute of ElementInternals
interface.  It accepts "unfocusable", "focusable", and "simple-control",
and affects focus behavior of ElementInternals' target element.

This fixes w3c/webcomponents#762
